Thanks,

actions.text:
Hi Marcus —

Thanks for reaching out and for the kind words about my React work. This project sounds well scoped and I’m interested. A few quick questions so I can confirm fit and availability:

1) Can you share your REST API docs or a sample response for the key endpoints I’d visualize? Any rate limits or auth requirements I should know about?
2) What authentication method do you want for users (your existing auth, OAuth, JWT, etc.) and do you need role-based admin UI for managing users/permissions?
3) For real-time updates, do you prefer WebSockets, Server-Sent Events, or periodic polling? Are you open to using libraries other than D3 for charts (Recharts, Visx, Chart.js) if they accelerate delivery?
4) Confirming budget of $5k–$6k and a ~4 week timeline — is that flexible if scope changes, and do you have milestones or an expected start date next month?
5) Would you like a short call to align on scope and acceptance criteria? I’m available for a 30-minute call on weekdays (mornings CST preferred) — share a few times that work for you.

If you can send the API docs and any design references, I’ll reply with a proposed plan, milestone breakdown, and ETA.

Thanks,
Jordan Mitchell
ML Engineer

actions.text:
Hi Sarah —

Great to hear the design was approved and thanks for the payment — much appreciated! A few quick items before I deliver the final assets and handoff:

1) Do you want the final files delivered as a Figma handoff + optimized assets (SVG/PNG) and a brief style guide, or do you prefer a zip with HTML/CSS/JS for direct deployment?
2) Will your dev team handle deployment, or should I include deployment support (I can deploy to your hosting/staging for an additional fee)?
3) Any final copy or meta tags you want added before I deliver the live-ready build?
4) For future projects, what’s the best way to scope features/estimate budget — a short kickoff call or a written brief works for you?

If it’s helpful, I’m available for a 20–30 minute call to walk through the handoff and next steps — mornings CST this week work well for me. Let me know what you prefer and I’ll prepare the final package.

Thanks,
Jordan Mitchell
